title: Expose board worktree dispatch via kanban CLI verb
body:
Problem: board-managed dispatch — claim the card, optionally create the worktree (.foreman/worktrees/<id>, branch card/<id>), spawn the agent with the generated dispatch prompt (# Workspace section, integrate/wait close-out lines, Card: trailer) — only exists in the board UI. An orchestrating agent inside foreman can't do it: it has to hand-roll git worktrees, which skips the integration queue, teardown, and orphan tracking. Observed: a Codex orchestrator said "board-managed worktree dispatch is available through its UI, not the CLI" and fell back to manual worktrees.

Goal: add a CLI verb (e.g. `foreman kanban dispatch <id> --agent <name> [--worktree|--no-worktree]`, default = the app's worktree setting, same as the chip) that goes through exactly the same path as the UI. Reply with the spawned terminal/project ids, in the same shape as `open`, so the caller can `kanban wait` on it.

Pointers:
- UI side: src/board.rs pushes `BoardAct::Dispatch { id, agent, worktree }` (the "Start with" agent buttons and the "wt on/off" chip; `worktree_choice_for`, `AGENTS`).
- Handler: the `BoardAct::Dispatch` arm in src/wm.rs does the real work (missing-card check, teardown-in-flight refusal, worktree bring-up, spawn). Reuse it; don't fork it. Pull the body into a method that both the board act and a new control request call.
- Control plane: src/control.rs — `KanbanRequest` / `parse_kanban_args` / `kanban_main` / HELP_KANBAN; the GUI handles it via `CtrlMsg::Kanban` → wm.rs `handle_ctrl`. Keep wire compat v1 (new optional fields use skip_serializing_if), and keep the REPLY_TIMEOUT / at-most-once rules: if the reply channel is dead, undo the spawn the way `open` does. Worktree bring-up must not hold the GUI thread past REPLY_TIMEOUT.
- Validate --agent against AGENTS. Reject cards that aren't in backlog, or are held by a live Session (same guard as `start`).
- Docs: update the foreman-kanban skill copies (.claude/skills and .codex/skills, embedded via src/skills_install.rs) — remove the "there is no CLI flag" line in the Worktrees section and document the verb. See the foreman-change-control skill for the wire-compat and skill-copy rules.

Tests: parse_kanban_args cases (flags, bad agent, missing id); wm-level test for the extracted method covering the worktree on/off and refusal branches (there are existing BoardAct::Dispatch tests in wm.rs to copy from).
